indexes.expression: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX budgets_household_id_name_lower_unique ON public.budgets USING btree (household_id, lower((name)::text)) WHERE (deleted_at IS NULL)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX categories_household_id_name_lower_unique ON public.categories USING btree (household_id, lower((name)::text)) WHERE (deleted_at IS NULL)
